_comment: Functional groups of skills that cover neighbouring jobs. Each member has one role; tools/apply_skill_groups.py writes a 'Role and Scope' section from this file into every member's SKILL.md, and tests/test_duplicates.py checks it. Platform variants of the same tool (e.g. brand-protection-*) are not listed: they differ by platform, not by job.
